description: Estimate transaction costs under different market conditions (standard, high MEV risk, low gas): base/priority/max fees in gwei, and estimated gas costs in ETH + USD for a simple swap, complex swap, and liquidity add. Includes MEV risk assessment (low/medium/high) and recommendations for MEV protection. Use for trading cost analysis, MEV risk evaluation, and timing decisions. Costs $0.04 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
